title: skill-evals case
description: The case.json of a skill-evals case: the checks that a run of its prompt must pass.

$schema.description: The address of this schema, for editors.

weight.title: weight
weight.description: How much the case counts in its suite. Default: 1.

minScore.title: minScore
minScore.description: The lowest score the case may get and still pass.

maxTurns.title: maxTurns
maxTurns.description: The most turns the agent may take. Only Claude Code applies it.

timeoutSeconds.title: timeoutSeconds
timeoutSeconds.description: The seconds a run may take. Default: 600.

requires.title: requires
requires.description: A list of capabilities the case needs, such as `"mcp"`, or `"bin:<name>"` for an executable on the host's `PATH`. A harness that lacks one reports the case as not applicable.

harnesses.title: harnesses
harnesses.description: The harness ids the case is for. Any other harness reports it as not applicable. Needs `note`. A last resort: prefer `requires`.

note.title: note
note.description: Why the case is limited to `harnesses`. The report shows it.

tags.title: tags
tags.description: Labels for selecting cases with `--tag`, `--tag-all` and `--not-tag`. Each is lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.

description.title: description
description.description: What the case shows, in a sentence.

targets.title: targets
targets.description: The names of the skills the case is about. The report counts the cases of each in its coverage table.

kind.title: kind
kind.description: The kind of case, such as `trigger` or `negative`.

expected.title: expected
expected.description: What a good run does, in a sentence. It is for readers; no check reads it.

guard.title: guard
guard.description: True for a case that must keep passing. The report lists it in its own table. Its score counts in the suite score like any other. Default: false.

reps.title: reps
reps.description: Runs for each subject in this case, in place of `--reps`.

model.title: model
model.description: The model of the agent in this case, in place of `--model`.

judgeModel.title: judgeModel
judgeModel.description: The model that scores the judged checks of this case, in place of `--judge-model`.

env.title: env
env.description: Variables the agent's process gets, with the values given here. A name starts with `CASE_`, or is `TZ`, `LANG` or `LC_ALL`.

minDelta.title: minDelta
minDelta.description: The least score difference, B minus A, that the case must show. A number from -1 to 1; a negative number lets B score lower by at most that much.

variants.title: variants
variants.description: A non-empty list of variants: the same case put differently, such as a paraphrase or a pressure. Each runs as `<case id>@<variant id>`, and the case never runs bare. See the variant keys below.

variant.title: variant
variant.description: The same case put differently. It runs as `<case id>@<variant id>`.

id.title: id
id.description: The variant's name: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, unique within the case. The case runs as `<case id>@<id>`.

prompt.title: prompt
prompt.description: The whole prompt of the variant, in place of `prompt.md`. Give this or `promptAppend`, not both.

promptAppend.title: promptAppend
promptAppend.description: Text added to the case's `prompt.md` after a blank line. Needs a `prompt.md`. Give this or `prompt`, not both.

heldout.title: heldout
heldout.description: True for a variant that runs only with `--heldout`, so that tuning a skill does not see it. Default: false.

tags.title: tags
tags.description: Tags added to the case's tags for this variant.

check-skill_loaded.title: skill_loaded
check-skill_loaded.description: The agent loaded that skill, or any of the skills in `anyOf`. With `first: true` the first skill load must be a named skill, and no tool call that does not fit `ignoring` may come before it; every call of the run counts, a subagent's included, because calls cannot yet be told apart by the agent that made them. It takes exactly one of `skill` and `anyOf`, and `ignoring` only with `first`.

weight.title: weight
weight.description: A positive number that says how much it counts. Default: 1.

anyOf.title: anyOf
anyOf.description: A list of skill names, any of which is accepted. Give this or `skill`, not both.

first.title: first
first.description: True to require the first thing the agent did to be what the check names: for `tool_called`, the run's first tool call fits the matcher fields; for `skill_loaded`, the first skill load is the skill, and no tool call outside `ignoring` comes before it. Default: false.

ignoring.title: ignoring
ignoring.description: Matchers for calls to leave out before looking at the first call, such as a read the agent is allowed to make first.

kind.title: kind
kind.description: What the tool does, with the same word in every harness.

name.title: name
name.description: A regular expression for the harness's own tool name.

inputMatches.title: inputMatches
inputMatches.description: A regular expression for the tool call's input, written as JSON.

flags.title: flags
flags.description: The flags of the check's regular expressions.

requires.title: requires
requires.description: A list of capabilities the check needs, such as `"mcp"`, or `"bin:<name>"` for an executable on the host's `PATH`. A harness that lacks one cannot run the check.

ifUnsupported.title: ifUnsupported
ifUnsupported.description: What a harness that lacks what the check needs does: "skip" drops this check and re-normalizes the weights, "not-applicable" excludes the whole case. Default: "not-applicable".

check-skill_not_loaded.description: The agent did not load that skill.

check-tool_called.title: tool_called
check-tool_called.description: The agent made tool calls that fit every given field, and their number is from `min` to `max`. With `sameTurn`, they were all issued in one assistant turn. A count sees every call of the run, a subagent's included: calls cannot yet be told apart by the agent that made them. `sameTurn` needs a harness with `turnGrouping`; elsewhere the case is not applicable.

weight.title: weight
weight.description: A positive number that says how much it counts. Default: 1.

flags.description: The flags of the check's regular expressions.

min.title: min
min.description: The fewest matching calls that pass: a whole number, 0 or more. Default: 1.

max.title: max
max.description: The most matching calls that pass: a whole number, 0 or more. Default: no limit.

sameTurn.title: sameTurn
sameTurn.description: True to require every matching call to be issued in one assistant turn, so that `min` and `max` count calls that were launched together. A matching call with no turn fails it, unless it is the only match. Needs a harness with `turnGrouping`. Default: false.

first.title: first
first.description: True to require the first thing the agent did to be what the check names: for `tool_called`, the run's first tool call fits the matcher fields; for `skill_loaded`, the first skill load is the skill, and no tool call outside `ignoring` comes before it. Default: false.

check-tool_order.title: tool_order
check-tool_order.description: The calls come in the order given: with `before` and `after`, the chosen `before` call is earlier than the chosen `after` call; with `sequence`, the matchers match calls in that order. It takes exactly one of the pair `before` and `after`, and `sequence`. With `strict: true` a sequence also forbids a later matcher's call before an earlier matcher's first match, and an earlier matcher's call after a later matcher's first match: `[researcher, synthesizer]` allows two researchers, then the synthesizer, and no researcher after it. The check sees every call of the run, a subagent's included: calls cannot yet be told apart by the agent that made them.
